notes.content:
Update v0.01.3041 beta
Fixed a bug: at an easy level, the level of the soldier's level did not affect their characteristics
Fixed a bug: very slow response to clicking buttons in the interface
Improvement: you can go through the previous level again
Improvement: you can, without losing progress, find all the runes and chests

notes.title: Update v0.01.3032 beta
notes.content:
1. Improvement: Added 2 neutral cards, which can be played several times
2. Improved: Added difficulty level (Default Light)
      A. Soldier - Easy difficulty level
      B. Warrior - Medium difficulty
      C. Hero - High difficulty level
3. Improvement: The number of archers in auxiliary units is reduced
4. Improvement: The level of the enemy, affects its characteristics as well as the player's
5. Improvement: The balance of heroes
6. Bug fix
7. Bug: Level 15 understated the health of the tower (the hero). Health was increased

notes.title: Update v0.01.3029 beta
notes.content:
- Fixed a bug: The egg could be sold several times
- Fixed a bug: The enemy's level was higher than assigned to him on the map
- Improvement: increased drop-out gold from the opponent from 50-250 to 100-320
- Improvement: Magic is open initially (the riddle of the old man gives another resource)
- Improvement: If you skip the splash screen, it will no longer be displayed
- Improvement: The level of the war gives more damage when destroying the enemy that is suitable for the chosen warrior (for example, the higher the level of the Cavalry, the faster it will deal with the archers)
- Improved: Increased the experience for killing an enemy from 10 to 30 ordinary soldiers, and from 30 to 500 hero
- Improved: Increased damage and health of heroes
- Correcting minor bugs
